limitations.note: The agent corrected the low-bit XOR but also replaced the registered decode-and-increment pipeline with combinational feedback and an explicit phase bit, changing the internal clock-edge behavior even though all 421 graded output samples matched.

limitations.quote: verify their bit slices and comparison constants against the pattern before changing the pipeline
